# README table generation {#readme-tabellgenerering}

## Why auto-generated tables? {#kvifor-auto-genererte-tabellar}

README.md contains three tables that give an overview of the repository's structure. These tables are **generated automatically** to ensure:

- **Consistency** — identical format and structure across all entries
- **Less maintenance** — new schemas and domains show up automatically
- **Fewer errors** — no manual copying of file paths or links

The tables are generated by `src/assets/scripts/makefile/generate-readme-tables.sh` and inserted between HTML comments in README.md. CI runs the script automatically on changes in `src/linkml/`, but you can also run it manually.

---

## Table overview and sources {#tabelloversikt-og-kjelder}

| # | Table | Content | Source | Function in generate-readme-tables.sh |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Schema table** | All LinkML schemas per domain with descriptions and documentation links | **100 % auto-generated** from schema files via `extract-schema-metadata.py` | `generate_schema_table()` (lines 25-92) |
| 2 | **Concept catalog table** | Automatically generated concept catalogs per organization | **100 % auto-generated** from schema files | `generate_begrepskatalog_table()` (lines 94-124) |
| 3 | **Model catalog table** | Automatically generated model catalogs per organization | **100 % auto-generated** from schema files | `generate_modellkatalog_table()` (lines 126-156) |

---

## 1. Schema table {#1-skjematabell}

### What the table contains {#kva-tabellen-inneheld}

```markdown
| Domene | Skjema | Skildring | Dokumentasjon |
|---|---|---|---|
| [fair](fair/) | [fair-metadata](fair/fair-metadata/) | **FAIR**-metadataoverbygning | [www.go-fair.org](https://...) |
| [ap-no](ap-no/) | [dcat-ap-no](ap-no/dcat-ap-no/) | Standard for beskrivelse av datasett, ... | [data.norge.no](https://...) |
```

### How it is generated {#korleis-han-vert-generert}

**100 % auto-generated:**
- **Schema files are auto-discovered** from `src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/<skjema>-schema.yaml` (lines 35-57)
- **Descriptions are taken** from the `description:` field in each schema file via `extract-schema-metadata.py` (line 72)
- **Documentation links are taken** from the first URI in the `see_also:` list via `extract-schema-metadata.py` (line 75)

The script finds all `*-schema.yaml` files under `src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/`, but only includes **main schemas** where the file name matches the directory name (e.g. `modelldcat-ap-no/modelldcat-ap-no-schema.yaml` is included). A directory where the file name and directory name do not match (e.g. a schema placed according to the now unused `submodels:` pattern, see `build-config.md`) would be skipped.

**Domains that are included:** fair, ap-no, referanse, ngr, oreg, fint, samt (line 30)

**Domains that are excluded:** modellkatalog, begrepskatalog (these have their own tables)

### How to add a new schema {#korleis-legge-til-nytt-skjema}

**Step 1:** Create the schema with `make new-modell DOMAIN=<domene> NAME=<skjema>`

**Step 2:** Fill in `description:` and `see_also:` in the schema file `src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/<skjema>-schema.yaml`:

```yaml
description: >-
  Kort skildring av skjemaet som vises i README-tabellen.
  Multiline-format er støtta.

see_also:
  - https://www.eksempel.no/dokumentasjon
```

**Step 3:** Run `make readme-tables` — README.md is updated automatically

### Example {#eksempel}

If you create `src/linkml/oreg/folkeregisteret/folkeregisteret-schema.yaml`:

```yaml
# In src/linkml/oreg/folkeregisteret/folkeregisteret-schema.yaml
id: https://data.norge.no/oreg/folkeregisteret
name: folkeregisteret
title: Folkeregisteret
description: >-
  Personopplysningar frå Folkeregisteret ved Skatteetaten.
  Inneheld navn, adresse, fødselsnummer og relasjonar.
see_also:
  - https://www.skatteetaten.no/person/folkeregisteret/
```

The result is:

```markdown
| [oreg](oreg/) | [folkeregisteret](oreg/folkeregisteret/) | Personopplysningar frå Folkeregisteret ved Skatteetaten. Inneheld navn, adresse, fødselsnummer og relasjonar. | [skatteetaten.no](https://www.skatteetaten.no/person/folkeregisteret/) |
```

## 2. Concept catalog table {#2-begrepskatalog-tabell}

### What the table contains {#kva-tabellen-inneheld_1}

```markdown
| Domene | Begrepskatalog | Organisasjon | Skildring | Generator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [begrepskatalog](...) | [brreg-begrepskatalog](...) | Brønnøysundregistra | Begrepskatalog for Brønnøysundregistra sine begrep | [`gen-begrepskatalog-instance`](...) |
```

### How it is generated {#korleis-han-vert-generert_1}

**100 % auto-generated:**
- **Concept catalog files are auto-discovered** from `src/linkml/begrepskatalog/` (lines 102-123)
- **Organization names are extracted** from the `title:` field in the schema file by removing " - Begrepskatalog" (lines 107-114)

### How to add a new concept catalog {#korleis-legge-til-ny-begrepskatalog}

**Step 1:** Create the concept catalog skeleton (see [New organization](../kom-i-gang/ny-org.md))

**Step 2:** Fill in `title:` in the schema file `src/linkml/begrepskatalog/<katalog>/<katalog>-schema.yaml`:

```yaml
title: "Organisasjonsnavn - Begrepskatalog"
```

The organization name is extracted automatically by removing " - Begrepskatalog" from `title`.

**Step 3:** Run `make readme-tables`

### Example {#eksempel_1}

```yaml
# In src/linkml/begrepskatalog/statped-begrepskatalog/statped-begrepskatalog-schema.yaml
id: https://data.norge.no/begrepskatalog/statped
name: statped-begrepskatalog
title: "Statped - Begrepskatalog"
```

The result is:

```markdown
| [begrepskatalog](...) | [statped-begrepskatalog](...) | Statped | Begrepskatalog for Statped sine begrep | [`gen-begrepskatalog-instance`](...) |
```

---

## Dependencies {#avhengigheter}

`generate-readme-tables.sh` uses the Python script `extract-schema-metadata.py` to fetch metadata from LinkML schema files:

**`src/assets/scripts/makefile/extract-schema-metadata.py`**

Supported fields:
- `description` — multiline or single-line YAML value, strips `>-` and `>` and converts to single-line text
- `see_also` — the first URI in the list
- `title` — single-line YAML value
- `annotations.utgiver` — single-line YAML value

**Usage:**

```bash
python3 src/assets/scripts/makefile/extract-schema-metadata.py <skjemafil> <felt>
```

**Example:**

```bash
python3 src/assets/scripts/makefile/extract-schema-metadata.py \
  src/linkml/ngr/ngr-adresse/ngr-adresse-schema.yaml description

# Output: Adresseinformasjon frå Det sentrale folkeregisteret (DSF)
```

```bash
python3 src/assets/scripts/makefile/extract-schema-metadata.py \
  src/linkml/modellkatalog/brreg-modellkatalog/brreg-modellkatalog-schema.yaml title

# Output: Brønnøysundregistra - Modellkatalog
```

## CI integration {#ci-integrasjon}

### Automatic execution {#automatisk-kyring}

`generate-readme-tables.sh` runs automatically as part of `make docs-publish`
(the step «Oppdater README.md-tabellar» in `mkdocs/publish.sh`) — not as a
separate standalone workflow. `make docs-publish` is called from
`.github/workflows/generate.yml` (push to `main`) and
`.github/workflows/lenkje-og-mermaid-sjekk.yml` (nightly schedule).

### Manual execution {#manuell-kyring}

```bash
bash src/assets/scripts/makefile/generate-readme-tables.sh README.md
```

(There is no separate `make readme-tables` target — the script is normally
only called indirectly via `make docs-publish`.)

---

## Troubleshooting {#feilsking}

### My schema does not show up in the schema table {#skjemaet-mitt-dukkar-ikkje-opp-i-skjematabellen}

**Checklist:**

1. **Is the schema file in the right place?** → It should be `src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/<skjema>-schema.yaml`
2. **Does the file name match the directory name?** → The file name should be `<skjema>-schema.yaml` and the directory should be called `<skjema>`
3. **Is the domain in the domain order?** → See line 30 in `generate-readme-tables.sh`:

   ```bash
   DOMAIN_ORDER=("fair" "ap-no" "referanse" "ngr" "oreg" "fint" "samt")
   ```

   If your domain is not in this list, add it.

4. **Have you set the `description:` field?** → See [How to add a new schema](#korleis-legge-til-nytt-skjema)

### My description is not shown {#skildringa-mi-vert-ikkje-vist}

Check that the `description:` field is set in the schema file:

```bash
grep -A 5 "^description:" src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/<skjema>-schema.yaml
```

If `description:` is missing, add it:

```yaml
description: >-
  Kort skildring av skjemaet.
```

**Debugging:** Test the metadata extraction directly:

```bash
python3 src/assets/scripts/makefile/extract-schema-metadata.py \
  src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/<skjema>-schema.yaml description
```

If the output is empty, check the YAML syntax in the schema file.

### My documentation link is not shown {#dokumentasjonslenkja-mi-vert-ikkje-vist}

Check that the `see_also:` field is set in the schema file and contains at least one URI:

```bash
grep -A 3 "^see_also:" src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/<skjema>-schema.yaml
```

If `see_also:` is missing, add it:

```yaml
see_also:
  - https://www.eksempel.no/dokumentasjon
```

**Debugging:** Test the metadata extraction directly:

```bash
python3 src/assets/scripts/makefile/extract-schema-metadata.py \
  src/linkml/<domene>/<skjema>/<skjema>-schema.yaml see_also
```

### The organization name for the model catalog/concept catalog is wrong {#organisasjonsnavnet-for-modellkatalogbegrepskatalog-er-feil}

The organization name is extracted from the `title:` field in the schema file by removing " - Modellkatalog" or " - Begrepskatalog":

```bash
python3 src/assets/scripts/makefile/extract-schema-metadata.py \
  src/linkml/modellkatalog/<katalog>/<katalog>-schema.yaml title

# Expected: "Organisasjonsnavn - Modellkatalog"
```

If `title:` does not follow the pattern, the organization name becomes "Ukjend" ("Unknown"). Correct the `title:` field in the schema file:

```yaml
# Correct
title: "Brønnøysundregistra - Modellkatalog"

# Wrong (missing " - Modellkatalog")
title: "Brønnøysundregistra"
```
